timed_c_kernel.range: Actual timed kernel loop in _main,0x100003800..0x100003848, after cache flush and initial timestamp; separate from unused polybench_original_main and warmup.
timed_c_kernel.per_iteration: Three new F64 source loads, eight ordered adds, one divide, one store. Source-row neighbors and prior output remain in FP registers across adjacent columns. This is static executed-loop structure, not measured hardware traffic.
timed_c_kernel.no_reassociation_request: Keep original separate operations/tree; reuse already read values and previous completed writes. Do not introduce independent SIMD for dependent outputs.
